questions.q: This command tests IP connectivity between a source device and a destination by sending ICMP echo requests.
This OSI layer is responsible for transmitting raw bits over physical media, such as copper cables and fiber-optic connections.
This network configuration parameter determines which portion of an IP address identifies the network and which portion identifies the host.
his Layer 2 protocol prevents switching loops by placing redundant paths into a blocking state.
questions.a: What is the Spanning Tree Protocol (STP)?

questions.q: This technique divides a switched network into separate logical broadcast domains to limit broadcast traffic.
This unencrypted web protocol traditionally uses TCP port 80 to request and deliver web pages.
This encrypted web protocol commonly uses TCP port 443 to protect browser-to-server traffic with TLS.
This encrypted remote-login protocol uses TCP port 22 by default and is also used by tools such as SCP for secure file transfer.
This name-resolution protocol uses port 53 over UDP for many queries and TCP for transfers and some responses.
This network-management protocol uses UDP port 161 for queries sent from a manager to an agent.
